THE_STRUCTURAL_GATE_FIRES_FOR_THE_FIRST_.registered_reading: THE MERGE-CLOSURE GATE -- the half of the census gate that has NO FLAG and cannot be released -- FIRES AT K=2,048, at one token, and does NOT fire at K=1,024. cells.the_question_this_cell_asks: WHERE DOES EVEN THE COPY DIE?  ARCH.V3CL768 holds one case and what holds it is an ECHO: eleven of sixteen lanes return the prompt itself and the held lane is the whole summarisation prompt INCLUDING the instruction line, 484 characters with one visible corruption.  Column A is therefore not measuring intelligence at this depth; it is measuring ECHO PERSISTENCE, and this cell asks where the echo stops.
cells.two_accounts_that_disagree: THE MANDATORY-ROWS ACCOUNT predicts ONE.  The 256 ByteLevel alphabet rows are mandatory at every K, so the child can always SPELL any English text in principle, and the ladder has read 1 at three of its last four rungs (K=5,120: 1, K=4,096: 0, K=3,072: 1).  THE ECHO-BUDGET ACCOUNT predicts ZERO, and it is a claim about TOKENS and not about coverage: an echo is bounded by the generation cap in tokens, merges retained fall 2,307 -> 1,283 (-44.4 per cent), so the same 484-character paragraph must be spelled from shorter pieces and costs more tokens to reach the end of.  ARCH.V3CL768 already had ALL SIXTEEN lanes charged and ONE riding the cap.
cells.registered_on: THE ECHO-BUDGET ACCOUNT, AND THE MECHANISM OF DEATH IS REGISTERED WITH IT SO THE PREDICTION IS NOT ONLY A NUMBER: the summarisation lane is registered to START as an echo and TRUNCATE -- to ride the cap without reaching the decision (Supplier B) and the unresolved risk (the factory expansion slipping by one week).  If it reads 0 by INCOHERENCE instead -- an echo that does not start, or debris -- the count is right and the mechanism is wrong, and this document says which is which before the dossier is opened.
